landing.metaTitle: Agora — Meet your people in real life
landing.metaDesc: Tell Agora the kind of night you want. We find the room — nearby events that match your taste in music, sport, film, and conversation.
landing.heroSub: We work too much. We scroll too much. We meet too little. Agora finds you small, real-world gatherings tonight — picked from your taste in music, sport, film, and the things you actually care about.
landing.pillar1Desc: “Quiet bar with people who like Phoebe Bridgers.” “Sunday long run, 10k pace.” Type it. We'll match it.
landing.pillar2Desc: Coffee roasters, climbing gyms, film clubs, run crews. Local hosts, not algorithms.
landing.pillar3Desc: No swipes. No DMs. RSVP and walk in. The room does the rest.
landing.hostsTitle: Your room. Filled with the right people.
landing.hostsDesc: Coffees, gyms, trainers, restaurants, clubs — list a gathering and Agora puts it in front of locals who already want exactly what you're offering. See what your neighborhood is asking for tonight. Turn one-time attendees into a community you own.
landing.demandLabel: Tonight near you, people are asking for
landing.hostsFooter: Built-in CRM. Lead lists. Demand signals. One app.
landing.closingDesc: Less scrolling. More showing up. Your next favorite night is probably ten minutes away.

exec.notConfigured: No AI agent is configured on this server, so Agora ran its fixed plan with the same tools.
exec.ranked: Qloo ranked Agora's landmarks for your favourites.
exec.rankingEmpty: Qloo answered with an empty ranking for these favourites — no personalised ranking.
exec.agentPlan: A tool-calling agent ({{model}}) chose which tools to call and submitted the plan in {{steps}} step(s). Rankings, restaurants, events and stories come from the tools below, not from the model.
exec.agentNoPlan: The agent ({{model}}) ran {{steps}} step(s) but did not submit a plan, so Agora completed the plan with its fixed steps using the same tools.
exec.agentTimeout: The agent ({{model}}) did not answer in time, so Agora ran its fixed plan with the same tools.
exec.agentFailed: The agent ({{model}}) failed, so Agora ran its fixed plan with the same tools.
exec.rankingMismatch: Qloo answered with {{upstream}} item(s) ({{parsed}} readable), but {{matched}} belong to Agora's landmark shortlist — so no personalised ranking.

guide.intro: Add one to three things you love. Qloo's taste graph ranks the city's landmarks for you, Agora tells each place's story — history and legend kept apart — and finds a table and a gathering nearby.

guide.rule: One favourite is enough; three give Qloo more to work with. Only these words go to Qloo — never your name, email or location.
guide.onlyOtherKinds: Qloo has nothing of this kind by that name — only other kinds, listed below.
